label: esr
description: Arm A-profile CPU 系统寄存器

registers.name: ESR_EL1
registers.fullName: Exception Syndrome Register (EL1)
registers.description: 异常综合征寄存器。保存异常被捕获到 EL1 时的综合征信息。EC[31:26]指示异常类别，ISS[24:0]位域含义随EC变化。ISS2[55:32]为扩展ISS。

fields.name: ISS2
fields.description: 扩展指令特定综合征。Data Abort: DPOIndex[23:17], OverlayFetch[16], LST2[15:13], Unpriv[12], TPLIM/HDBSSF[11], TnD[10], TagAccess[9], GCS[8], AssuredOnly[7], Overlay[6], DirtyBit[5], Xs[4:0]。Inst Abort: FPOIndex[23:17], OverlayFetch[16], RES0[15:12], HDBSSF[11], RES0[10:8], AssuredOnly[7], Overlay[6], RES0[5:0]。Watchpoint: RES0[23:9], GCS[8], RES0[7:0]。其他异常res0

fields.name: EC
fields.description: 异常类别(Exception Class)。0x00=未知原因 0x01=WF*陷阱 0x03=MCR/MRC陷阱(coproc=0b1111) 0x04=MCRR/MRRC陷阱(coproc=0b1111) 0x05=MCR/MRC陷阱(coproc=0b1110) 0x06=LDC/STC陷阱 0x07=SME/SVE/ASIMD/FP陷阱(CPACR/CPTR) 0x09=Pointer Auth指令陷阱 0x0A=非法指令(不适用其他EC) 0x0C=MRRC陷阱(coproc=0b1110) 0x0D=Branch Target异常 0x0E=非法执行状态 0x11=SVC AArch32 0x14=MSRR/MRRS/128位系统指令陷阱 0x15=SVC AArch64 0x16=HVC AArch64 0x17=SMC AArch64 0x18=MSR/MRS/System指令陷阱 0x19=SVE陷阱(CPACR.ZEN) 0x1A=ERET/ERETAA/ERETAB陷阱 0x1C=PAC Fail 0x1D=SME陷阱 0x20=Instruction Abort(Lower EL) 0x21=Instruction Abort(Same EL) 0x22=PC对齐 0x24=Data Abort(Lower EL) 0x25=Data Abort(Same EL) 0x26=SP对齐 0x27=Memory Operation异常 0x28=FP异常(AArch32) 0x2C=FP异常(AArch64) 0x2D=GCS异常 0x2E=非法TIndex Change 0x2F=SError中断 0x30=Breakpoint(Lower EL) 0x31=Breakpoint(Same EL) 0x32=SW Step(Lower EL) 0x33=SW Step(Same EL) 0x34=Watchpoint(Lower EL) 0x35=Watchpoint(Same EL) 0x38=BKPT(AArch32) 0x3C=BRK(AArch64) 0x3D=Profiling。保留EC值为CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: IL
fields.description: 指令长度。0b0=16-bit。0b1=32-bit。SError/Inst Abort/PC对齐/SP对齐/ISV=0的Data Abort/非法执行状态/除BKPT/BRK外调试异常强制为1。BKPT:0=16-bit T32 1=32-bit A32 BKPT或A64 BRK。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: ISS
fields.description: 指令特定综合征(Instruction Specific Syndrome)。根据EC字段不同，ISS位域布局不同。常见编码请见ESR_EL1_ISS系列条目。ISS子字段保存寄存器号时返回AArch64视图寄存器编号。AArch32的0b1111映射为0b11111或UNKNOWN值

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_DataAbort
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for Data Abort (EC=0x24/0x25)
registers.description: 当EC=0x24(Lower EL)或0x25(Same EL)时为Data Abort。ISS[24:0]布局: ISV[24], SAS[23:22], SSE[21], SRT[20:16], SF/FnP[15], AR/PFV[14], RES0[13], LST/SET[12:11], FnV[10], EA[9], CM[8], S1PTW[7], WnR[6], DFSC[5:0]。bit[15]和bit[14]的含义取决于ISV值

fields.name: ISV
fields.description: 指令综合征有效。0b0=ISS[23:14]无效 0b1=ISS[23:14]含{SAS,SSE,SRT,SF,AR}。ISV=1条件: 非stage-2/stage-1 TTW fault、非同步External abort、单GP寄存器load/store(含Acquire/Release 不含Exclusive/writeback)或AArch32 LDR/LDA/LDRT/STR/STL系列(无寄存器写回 非R15) 且FEAT_EAESR时为stage-1 Trans/Access/Permission fault。ISV=0: MOPS访问/Allocation Tag直接访问/GCS数据访问/VNCR_EL2转换访问/Atomic访问。RAS未实现时stage-2 TTW External abort的ISV实现定义。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: SAS
fields.description: 综合征访问大小(ISV=1)。0b00=Byte 0b01=Halfword 0b10=Word 0b11=Doubleword。LD64B/ST64B/ST64BV/ST64BV0强制0b11。ISV未知时未知。否则res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: SSE
fields.description: 综合征符号扩展(ISV=1)。0b0=不需要 0b1=需要(byte/halfword/word load)。LD64B/ST64B/ST64BV/ST64BV0强制0。ISV未知时未知。否则res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: SRT
fields.description: 综合征寄存器传输(ISV=1)。Wt/Xt/Rt寄存器号(5-bit)。AArch32报告AArch64视图寄存器号。ISV未知时未知。ISV=0且FEAT_RASv2且DFSC=010000/01001x/0101xx: bits[4:2]=res0 bits[1:0]=WU(Write Update):0b00=非store或位置可能已更新 0b10=store未更新 0b11=store已更新。否则res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: SF
fields.description: 64位传输标志(ISV=1)。0b0=32-bit寄存器 0b1=64-bit寄存器(指寄存器宽度 非执行状态)。LD64B/ST64B/ST64BV/ST64BV0强制1。ISV未知时未知。与FnP共享bit[15]

fields.name: FnP
fields.description: FAR不精确(ISV=0 FEAT_SVE/SME)。0b0=FAR保存精确故障VA 0b1=FAR保存包含故障VA的自然对齐granule内任意VA(SVE连续向量load/store或SME load/store)。复位值为架构UNKNOWN。与SF共享bit[15]

fields.name: AR
fields.description: Acquire/Release(ISV=1)。0b0=无acquire/release语义 0b1=有。LD64B/ST64B/ST64BV/ST64BV0强制0。ISV未知时未知。ISV=0且FEAT_PFAR且DFSC=010000/01001x/0101xx: PFV(PFAR Valid) 0b0=PFAR_EL1未知 0b1=PFAR_EL1有效。否则res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: LST
fields.description: Load/Store类型(DFSC=00xxxx/10101x且非0000xx)。0b00=不指定 0b01=ST64BV(FEAT_LS64_V) 0b10=LD64B/ST64B(FEAT_LS64) 0b11=ST64BV0(FEAT_LS64_ACCDATA)。RAS且DFSC=010000: SET(Sync Error Type):0b00=Recoverable(UER) 0b10=Uncontainable(UC) 0b11=Restartable(UEO)。否则res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: FnV
fields.description: FAR无效(仅DFSC=010000)。0b0=FAR有效 0b1=FAR无效保存UNKNOWN。其他abort类型res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: EA
fields.description: 外部Abort类型。IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED的External abort分类。非External abort为0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: CM
fields.description: Cache维护。0b0=非cache maintenance/地址翻译异常 0b1=cache maintenance指令或地址翻译指令同步错误(DC ZVA/GVA/GZVA不计)。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: S1PTW
fields.description: Stage-1页表遍历(仅stage-2 fault)。0b0=非stage-1 TTW的stage-2 fault 0b1=stage-1 TTW访问上的stage-2 fault。非stage-2 fault时res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: WnR
fields.description: 写而非读。0b0=读访问异常 0b1=写访问异常。cache maintenance/地址翻译指令总是1。原子指令:按首次访问判断;stage-2/stage-1 TTW原子指令允许总是0。FEAT_RASv2时WU=0b00的External abort/DFSC=110101(不支持Exclusive/Atomic)/DFSC=110001(不支持原子硬件更新)时UNKNOWN。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: DFSC
fields.description: 数据故障状态码。0b000000=地址大小L0 000001=地址大小L1 000010=地址大小L2 000011=地址大小L3 000100=翻译错误L0 000101=翻译错误L1 000110=翻译错误L2 000111=翻译错误L3 001000=AF错误L0(FEAT_LPA2) 001001=AF错误L1 001010=AF错误L2 001011=AF错误L3 001100=权限错误L0(FEAT_LPA2) 001101=权限错误L1 001110=权限错误L2 001111=权限错误L3 010000=同步External abort(非TTW) 010001=同步Tag Check(MTE2/VMTETCE) 010010=同步External abort TTW L-2(FEAT_D128) 010011=同步External abort TTW L-1(FEAT_LPA2) 010100=同步External abort TTW L0 010101=同步External abort TTW L1 010110=同步External abort TTW L2 010111=同步External abort TTW L3 011000=同步奇偶校验错误 110001=不支持原子硬件更新 110101=不支持Exclusive/Atomic。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_InstAbort
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for Instruction Abort (EC=0x20/0x21)
registers.description: 当EC=0x20(Lower EL)或0x21(Same EL)时为Instruction Abort。ISS[24:0]简单布局: RES0[24:7], IFSC[6:0]。

fields.name: RES0_24_7
fields.description: 保留，res0。Inst Abort不提供ISV类指令综合征

fields.name: IFSC
fields.description: 指令故障状态码。000000=地址大小L0 000100=翻译错误L0 000101=翻译错误L1 000110=翻译错误L2 000111=翻译错误L3 001001=AF错误L1 001010=AF错误L2 001011=AF错误L3 001101=权限错误L1 001110=权限错误L2 001111=权限错误L3 010000=同步External abort 010100-010111=同步External abort(TTW各级) 011000=同步奇偶校验。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_SError
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for SError Interrupt (EC=0x2F)
registers.description: 当EC=0x2F时为SError中断。ISS[24:0]布局: IDS[24], RES0[23:19], ELS[18], WU[17:16], VFV[15], PFV[14], IESB[13], AET[12:10], EA[9], RES0[8], WnRV[7], WnR[6], DFSC[5:0]。旧版架构中SError也称为SError中断或异步External abort

fields.name: IDS
fields.description: 实现定义综合征。0b0=ISS[23:0]为架构定义字段 0b1=ISS[23:0]为实现定义信息。旧称ISV。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: ELS
fields.description: ELR含义(FEAT_RASv2且DFSC=010001)。0b0=异步 不指示触发源 0b1=同步 异常由ELR_ELx处指令触发(非精确也允许)。否则res0

fields.name: WU
fields.description: 写更新(FEAT_RASv2且DFSC=010001)。0b00=非store/位置可能已更新 0b10=store/翻译表更新未修改 0b11=store/翻译表更新已修改。否则res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: VFV
fields.description: FAR有效(FEAT_RASv2且DFSC=010001)。0b0=FAR_EL1无效 0b1=FAR_EL1含有效VA。否则res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: PFV
fields.description: PFAR有效(FEAT_PFAR且DFSC=010001)。0b0=PFAR_EL1未知 0b1=PFAR_EL1有效。否则res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: IESB
fields.description: 隐式错误同步事件(FEAT_IESB且DFSC=010001)。0b0=未由隐式错误同步事件同步/未立即/异常return实现选择0 0b1=由隐式错误同步事件同步且立即(异常entry强制1 异常return实现选择0/1)。否则res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: AET
fields.description: 异步错误类型(FEAT_RAS且DFSC=010001)。0b000=Uncontainable(UC) 0b001=Unrecoverable(UEU) 0b010=Restartable(UEO) 0b011=Recoverable(UER) 0b110=Corrected(CE)。其余保留。多错误合并报告总体PE状态。Corrected/Recoverable/Restartable=精确 Uncontainable=非精确。否则res0

fields.name: EA
fields.description: 外部Abort类型(FEAT_RAS且DFSC=010001)。IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED。否则res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: WnRV
fields.description: WnR有效(FEAT_RASv2且DFSC=010001)。0b0=WnR无效(已置0) 0b1=WnR有效。否则res0。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: WnR
fields.description: 写而非读(FEAT_RASv2且DFSC=010001)。WnRV=1：0b0=读取异常 0b1=写入异常。WnRV=0：res0。WU=0b00的Atomic access External abort：UNKNOWN。复位值为架构UNKNOWN

fields.name: DFSC
fields.description: 数据故障状态码(FEAT_RAS)。0b000000=未分类错误 0b010001=异步SError异常。其余保留。否则res0

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_SVC_HVC_SMC
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for SVC/HVC/SMC (EC=0x15/0x16/0x17)
registers.description: 当EC=0x15(SVC AArch64)、0x16(HVC AArch64)或0x17(SMC AArch64)时，ISS[15:0]保存指令中的16-bit立即数。EC=0x01的SVC AArch32类似

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_MSR_MRS
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for MSR/MRS/System Instructions (EC=0x18)
registers.description: 当EC=0x18时异常由MSR/MRS/System指令(排除EC 0x00/0x01/0x07的编码空间)引起。ISS保存系统指令编码域

fields.name: DIR
fields.description: 方向位。0b0=MRS(读取系统寄存器) 0b1=MSR(写入系统寄存器)

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_BRK
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for Breakpoint Instruction (EC=0x3C/0x38)
registers.description: 当EC=0x3C(BRK AArch64)或0x38(BKPT AArch32)时，ISS保存Breakpoint指令中的16-bit立即数

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_WFx
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for WF* Instruction (EC=0x01)
registers.description: 当EC=0x01时异常由WFI或WFE指令陷获引起。条件性WF*指令条件码检查失败不产生异常

fields.name: CV
fields.description: 条件码有效。0b0=非条件WF* 0b1=条件WF*(FEAT_WFxT)

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_MCR_MRC
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for MCR/MRC Access (EC=0x03/0x05)
registers.description: 当EC=0x03(MCR/MRC coproc=0b1111)或0x05(MCR/MRC coproc=0b1110)时，ISS保存协处理器指令编码域

fields.name: CV
fields.description: 条件码有效(AArch32)。0b0=指令非法 0b1=条件码满足或无条件指令

fields.name: CRm
fields.description: MCR/MRC指令CRm编码域(低2位;EC=0x03时bit[0]保留)

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_IllegalExec
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for Illegal Execution State/PC/SP Alignment (EC=0x0E/0x22/0x26)
registers.description: 当EC=0x0E(非法执行状态)、0x22(PC对齐错误)或0x26(SP对齐错误)时，ISS[24:0]全为res0

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_MCRR_MRRC
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for MCRR/MRRC Access (EC=0x04/0x0C)
registers.description: 当EC=0x04(MCRR/MRRC coproc=0b1111)或0x0C(MRRC coproc=0b1110)时，ISS保存协处理器双寄存器传输指令编码域

fields.name: CV
fields.description: 条件码有效(AArch32)。0b0=指令非法 0b1=条件码有效

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_LDC_STC
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for LDC/STC Instruction (EC=0x06)
registers.description: 当EC=0x06时异常由LDC或STC指令陷获引起。架构化用途:STC写DBGDTRRXint LDC读DBGDTRTXint

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_PACFail
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for PAC Fail (EC=0x34)
registers.description: 当EC=0x34时异常由Pointer Authentication Code验证失败引起

fields.name: PAC_ERR_CODE
fields.description: PAC错误码。0b00=返回地址PAC验证失败(ERETAA/ERETAB)

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_GCS
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for GCS Exception (EC=0x38)
registers.description: 当EC=0x38时异常由Guarded Control Stack(GCS)违规引起

fields.name: IT
fields.description: 指令类型。0b00000=过程返回指令(RET/ERET/ERETAA/ERETAB等) 0b00001=GCSPOPM 0b00010/00011=过程返回(目标X30) 0b00100=GCSSS1 0b00101/01000=UNKNOWN 0b01001=0b11111

fields.name: REG
fields.description: 寄存器号。IT=00000:返回目标地址所在寄存器。IT=00001:GCSPOPM目标寄存器。IT=00010/00011:0b11110(X30)。IT=00100:GCSSS1输入寄存器。IT=00101/01000:UNKNOWN。IT=01001:0b11111

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_BTI
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for Branch Target Exception (EC=0x31)
registers.description: 当EC=0x31时异常由Branch Target Identification(BTI)违规引起

fields.name: BTYPE
fields.description: 分支类型。指示引发BTI异常的具体违规类型

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_SWStep
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for Software Step (EC=0x32/0x33)
registers.description: 当EC=0x32(Lower EL)或0x33(Same EL)时异常由软件单步执行触发

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_Watchpoint
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for Watchpoint (EC=0x34/0x35)
registers.description: 当EC=0x34(Lower EL)或0x35(Same EL)时异常由数据观察点(Watchpoint)触发

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_Breakpoint
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for Breakpoint/Vector Catch (EC=0x30/0x31)
registers.description: 当EC=0x30(Lower EL)或0x31(Same EL)时异常由硬件断点或向量捕获(Vector Catch)触发

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_MOPS
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for Memory Operation Exception (EC=0x27)
registers.description: 当EC=0x27时异常由Memory Copy and Memory Set(FEAT_MOPS)指令引起

fields.name: Opc
fields.description: 操作类型。指示具体MOPS操作(CPY/CPYT/SETI等)

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_FP_Trap
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for Trapped FP Exception (EC=0x28/0x2C)
registers.description: 当EC=0x28(AArch32)或0x2C(AArch64)时异常由浮点异常陷获触发。是否支持浮点异常陷获是IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED

fields.name: TFV
fields.description: 陷获浮点有效(FEAT_AFP)。指示精确浮点异常信息是否可用

fields.name: FPEXC32
fields.description: FPEXC32_EL2相关。反映导致陷获的浮点异常类型(IOF/DZF/OFF/UFF/IXF等)

registers.name: ESR_EL1_ISS_Unknown
registers.fullName: ESR_EL1 ISS Encoding for Unknown Reason (EC=0x00)
registers.description: 当EC=0x00时异常原因未知。ISS[24:0]全为res0
